work.title: Hiinsides Bjergene
Jenseits der Berge
Beyond the Mountains
Hvo higed' vel ikke i Ungdommens Tid
Wer sehnte sich nicht in der Jugendzeit
O who hath not yearn'd in his youthful day

history.p: Hartmann was a close friend of the Norwegian poet Andreas Munch whose collection of poems "Sorg og Trøst" (Sorrow and Consolation) was published in 1852.
